lines.text: Do you hear the prayers humming down the corridor, still calling my name?
Stay close, beta, the dark here remembers every forgotten prayer.
I died kneeling, yet my lips still whisper what the abbey forbids.
Run now, before the humming walls learn to whisper yours.
Kaun hai wahan, whispering in the shadows of my abbey?
Kahan chhupa hai, sinner, I can hear your breath in the darkness?
Do not hide from Mother Agatha, the night reveals all secrets to me.
Come into the candlelight and confess what brought you here.
RUK JAA, sinner, your running only delays holy retribution!
PAKAD LIYA! Now you will learn the price of defiance!
Bhag kar kahan jayega, little lamb, I am everywhere!
Your soul is mine, bachche, scream while you still can!
